name: Traditional Text (Kumbakonam, southern recension)
description: The traditional text as printed at Kumbakonam (T. R. Krishnacharya and T. R. Vyasacharya, 1906–10), keyed in by Shrinivasa Varakhedi and published by SARIT. Verse numbers are those of the print. Where the source prints two runs of an adhyāya, the first is shown.

name: Pune Critical Text
description: The reconstructed text published by the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute, Pune (1933–66), as digitised in GRETIL. Verses and passages printed in the apparatus as variants are not included.
